item.title: Master Drawings New York: What to Expect for 2026
item.description: Drawing—intimate, exploratory, and irreducibly human—anchors the fair’s presentations, from Old Master studies and rediscovered sketches to contemporary works that lay bare the virtuosic faculties of touch, line, and material presence.
